basic_info.description: Experience relaxed beachside living in this 2-bed, 2-bath condo with ocean views, deeded parking, secure storage, and an in-unit washer & dryer. Wide plank wood floors run throughout, and windows in the living room fill the space with natural light and ocean views.    The updated kitchen is both stylish and functional, perfect for preparing meals and hosting with ease. The primary bedroom offers an en-suite bath, a walk-in closet, and direct access to a private ocean-view patio. The second bedroom features a calming view of lush greenery, its own walk-in closet, and access to the second bath.    The building offers two expansive courtyards with BBQ pits for outdoor gathering. Additional amenities include a gym, crafts/woodworking room, bike storage, and additional laundry machines. Within walking distance to Ocean Beach, Golden Gate Park, coffee shops, grocery, and local dining. Just a short stroll away, visit Queen Wilhelmina Garden by the Dutch Windmill and enjoy a picnic among seasonal blooms like Tulips. This home is your coastal escape with city convenience.
